text: Native source status stays blocked pending canonical application; actual actor acquisition, class/card gates, preparation, components and resource ledgers must exist.
Finite Animal Shapes mappings grant no Beast tag, CR, zoo/bestiary entry or Druid class-form permission. Unlisted species/stat blocks remain unavailable.
Actual origin anatomy, dimensions, body/cargo mass, limbs, fit, obstacles, legal squeeze, anchors and return placement are required; unknowns hold whole dependent branch.
Clone reproduction, stored-body injuries, environmental hazards/repair and current-versus-snapshot anatomy require actual source facts; no automatically viable container/body.
Actual death identity, willingness, soul/return barriers, planes and claim priority must be sourced; cross-plane Clone and unspecified soul topology are not authorized.
Flesh-to-Grave animation is unrated; actual body needs, NPC agency/goals, repair/healing eligibility and unsupported sizes/anatomy remain held. No army/loyalty/CR acquisition.
Actual care, food/water, rest time, recovery availability and independent strain inputs required; no free exhaustion recovery.
Recorded accepted snapshots control comparison scope. Later differing backing bytes, stale Companion integration text and historical Conference01 counts cannot expand accepted authority.
Retain all inherited dark-content, trauma, consent and player-character agency boundaries. Static mechanics never compel beliefs or silently retire a PC.
No game execution, runtime integration or human playtest performed or approved. Static fixtures are not campaign examples.
No balance, creature rating, resource-economy or performance approval.
No release, global rule promotion, domain closure, whole-game completion or canonical application.
Every original question/scenario/source hold and exact accepted comparison qualification is retained verbatim in source evidence; no hold is silently cleared by a local disposition.
